main_text.l: mentis constet nobis, in eo se, &

page.notes: The signature "ā 3" is read with a macron over the a; the bar is faint and may be a stroke of the a rather than a macron. The word "vestigasse" (printed "vestigasse") and the "u/v" forms were normalised as the rules require. The reading "in eo se" was printed "in eo fe" in the scan, read as long s. Nothing else on the page is doubtful.
